title: Suddenly…
goal: Tell a short story with birden, şol wagt and şondan soň, mixing -dY, -ýArdY and -(Y)pdY.

intro.text: A story sets its scene with `-ýArdY`, moves on with `-dY` and looks back with `-(Y)pdY`. Link it with *birden* (suddenly), *şol wagt* (at that moment) and *şondan soň* (after that): *Men okaýardym. Birden yşyk öçdi. Şol wagt biri gapyny kakdy.*

vocab.en: at that moment, just then; at that time

exercises.en: I was reading a book. Suddenly the light went out.
exercises.explain: *birden*, suddenly, brings in an event that breaks into the scene.

*ýykylypdy* looks back to before the walk. Here it happens during it: *ýykyldy*.

exercises.explain: The walk is the scene (*gezýärdik*); the fall is the event (*ýykyldy*).
*şondan soň* (or *ondan soň*), after that; *öýe gitdik*, we went home.

accept: [Just then|At that moment|Then|At that time] Merdan arrived.

exercises.title: Gijeki waka
exercises.passage:
Geçen gyş bir gije men öýde ýalňyz otyrdym. Daşarda güýçli gar ýagýardy. Men kitap okaýardym, birden yşyk öçdi. Öý garaňky boldy. Şol wagt biri gapyny kakdy. Men gorkdum. Gapyny açdym: goňşy Merdan eken! Onuň hem yşygy öçüpdi, onda çyra ýokdy.

Mende bir köne çyra bardy. Men ony Merdana berdim. Şondan soň biz bile çaý içdik we uzak gürleşdik. Irden yşyk ýene bardy. Men bu wakany hiç haçan ýatdan çykarmaryn.
exercises.translation: Last winter, one night, I was sitting at home alone. Outside, heavy snow was falling. I was reading a book, and suddenly the light went out. The house went dark. At that moment someone knocked at the door. I got scared. I opened the door: it was my neighbour Merdan! His light had gone out too, and he had no lamp. I had an old lamp. I gave it to Merdan. After that we drank tea together and talked for a long time. In the morning the light was back. I'll never forget that night.

questions.q: What was the narrator doing when the light went out?
questions.explain: *Men kitap okaýardym, birden yşyk öçdi*: the reading is the scene, the light going out the event.

options: His light had gone out too, and he had no lamp.
The snow had blocked his door.
questions.explain: *Onuň hem yşygy öçüpdi, onda çyra ýokdy*.

options: It had gone out before he knocked.
The narrator saw it go out.
questions.explain: `-(Y)pdY` looks back: his light had gone out earlier, before the knock at the door.
